# Dobr.AI Blog

> > A comprehensive resource for talent acquisition professionals on AI-powered technical hiring, FAANG-caliber assessments, and recruitment automation strategies.

Dobr.AI's blog provides research-backed insights and practical guides for HR leaders, technical recruiters, and talent acquisition teams looking to scale their hiring processes using AI-driven interviews, automated assessments, and enterprise-grade evaluation platforms. Content focuses on modern hiring technologies, industry benchmarks from companies like Google, Amazon, and Facebook, and strategic frameworks for building world-class technical recruiting programs.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered technical interviews
- FAANG hiring standards
- Technical assessment platforms (Codility, HackerRank, CodeSignal)
- Recruitment automation and AI interviewers
- Skills gap analysis
- Interview-as-a-Service (IaaS)
- Anti-cheating and fraud detection
- System design interviews
- Global talent acquisition
- ROI and hiring economics
- Structured interview methodologies
- Enterprise hiring at scale
- Adaptive questioning and IRT
- Technical recruiting best practices
